name: io.liftoff.liftoffads.interstitials.HTMLInterstitialActivity
description: Liftoff Ads opens this screen to show a full-screen HTML interstitial. It displays the ad with a close control and countdown and records when the ad is viewed.
disableEffect: Rewards for watching this HTML ad will no longer be granted; if the app requests one, Liftoff does not recover from a failed screen launch and the app may close.
